arxiv-2109-03867.title: LSB: Local Self-Balancing MCMC in Discrete Spaces
arxiv-2109-03867.creator: Emanuele Sansone
arxiv-2109-03867.description: Abstract We present the Local Self-Balancing sampler (LSB), a local Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method for sampling in purely discrete domains, which is able to autonomously adapt to the target distribution and to reduce the number of target evaluations required to converge.

arxiv-2208-03890.title: Fourth-order conservative non-splitting semi-Lagrangian Hermite WENO schemes for kinetic and fluid simulations
arxiv-2208-03890.creator: Nanyi Zheng, Xiaofeng Cai, Jing-Mei Qiu, Jianxian Qiu
arxiv-2208-03890.description: Abstract We present fourth-order conservative non-splitting semi-Lagrangian (SL) Hermite essentially non-oscillatory (HWENO) schemes for linear transport equations with applications for nonlinear problems including the Vlasov-Poisson system, the guiding center Vlasov model, and the incompressible Euler equations in the vorticity-stream function formulation.

arxiv-2209-10738.title: Pion superfluid phase transition under external magnetic field including inverse magnetic catalysis effect
arxiv-2209-10738.creator: Shijun Mao, Yvming Tian
arxiv-2209-10738.description: Abstract Pion superfluid phase transition under external magnetic field including the inverse magnetic catalysis (IMC) effect is investigated by the Pauli-Villars regularized NJL model. Based on the Goldstone’s theorem, we apply the massless Goldstone boson ( π + \pi^{+} meson) to determine the onset of pion superfluid phase.

arxiv-2210-04500.title: Turbulence drag modulation by dispersed droplets in Taylor-Couette flow: the effects of the dispersed phase viscosity
arxiv-2210-04500.creator: Cheng Wang 1, Lei Yi 1, Linfeng Jiang 1, Chao Sun 1, 2
arxiv-2210-04500.description: Abstract The dispersed phase in turbulence can vary from almost inviscid fluid to highly viscous fluid. By changing the viscosity of the dispersed droplet phase, we experimentally investigate how the deformability of dispersed droplets affects the global transport quantity of the turbulent emulsion.

arxiv-2306-12077.title: Learning Latent Dynamics via Invariant Decomposition and (Spatio-)Temporal Transformers
arxiv-2306-12077.creator: Kai Lagemann ∗, Christian Lagemann ∗, Sach Mukherjee
arxiv-2306-12077.description: Abstract We propose a method for learning dynamical systems from high-dimensional empirical data that combines variational autoencoders and (spatio-)temporal attention within a framework designed to enforce certain scientifically-motivated invariances. We focus on the setting in which data are available from multiple different instances of a system whose underlying dynamical model is entirely unknown at the outset.

arxiv-2401-12279.title: Relevance of one-loop SMEFT matching in the 2HDM
arxiv-2401-12279.creator: Supratim Das Bakshi, Sally Dawson, Duarte Fontes, Samuel Homiller
arxiv-2401-12279.description: Abstract The Two-Higgs Doublet Model (2HDM) is a well understood alternative to the Standard Model of particle physics. If the new particles included in the 2HDM are at an energy scale much greater than the weak scale, the theory can be matched to the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT).

arxiv-2405-00038.title: Getting a Handle on Unmanaged Memory
arxiv-2405-00038.creator: Nick Wanninger, Tommy McMichen, Simone Campanoni, Peter Dinda
arxiv-2405-00038.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nick Wanninger, Tommy McMichen, Simone Campanoni, Peter Dinda. The inability to relocate objects in unmanaged languages brings with it a menagerie of problems. Perhaps the most impactful is memory fragmentation, which has long plagued applications such as databases and web servers. These issues either fester or require Herculean programmer effort to address on a per-application basis because, in general, heap objects cannot be moved in unmanaged languages .

arxiv-2412-19788.title: Composite operators in 𝒩 = 𝟒 \boldsymbol{\mathcal{N}=4} Super Yang-Mills
arxiv-2412-19788.creator: Agnese Bissi a , b , c \,{}^{a,b,c}, Giulia Fardelli d \,{}^{d}, and Andrea Manenti b \,{}^{b}
arxiv-2412-19788.description: Abstract We consider four-point functions of protected, double- and single-trace operators in the large central charge limit. We use superconformal symmetry to disentangle the contribution of protected operators in the partial wave decomposition. With this information, we fix the non protected part of such correlators up to subleading order in the large central charge expansion.

arxiv-2501-04439.title: Bit reset protocols that obey activity-constrained speed limits do not minimize work for a given speed
arxiv-2501-04439.creator: Daan Mulder, Thomas E. Ouldridge, Pieter Rein ten Wolde
arxiv-2501-04439.description: Abstract The goal of thermodynamic optimal control theory is to find protocols to change the state of a system from an initial to a desired final distribution, within a finite time, with the least possible expenditure of work. The optimal protocol is closely linked to the intrinsic dynamics of the system at hand.

arxiv-2501-10690.title: Insights from the Application of Nonlinear Model Predictive Control to a Cart-Pendulum
arxiv-2501-10690.creator: Mark P. Balenzuela
arxiv-2501-10690.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mark P. Balenzuela. Inspired greatly by Mills et al. (2009) and the solution within, this paper aims to more clearly explain the mathematics and implementation details of such a powerful control algorithm. While the aforementioned paper is well written and of sound mathematics, it is extreamly dense and requires some time and patience to decipher, especially as it draws on many other sources to complete the algorithm.

arxiv-2504-11098.title: Electron-transverse acoustic phonon couplings in three-dimensional pentatellurides
arxiv-2504-11098.creator: Rui Min, Fuxiang Li, Yi-Xiang Wang
arxiv-2504-11098.description: Abstract Transverse acoustic (TA) phonon waves are analogous to electromagnetic waves and can carry a certain angular momentum. In this paper, we study the electron-TA phonon couplings in three-dimensional pentatellurides and explore the conditions under which the TA phonon condensation is stable.

arxiv-2510-26846.title: Enhanced production of charged over neutral kaons in Ar+Sc collisions measured by NA61/SHINE at CERN SPS
arxiv-2510-26846.creator: \firstname Tomasz \lastname Matulewicz \fnsep for the NA61/SHINE Collaboration
arxiv-2510-26846.description: Abstract The isospin symmetry, originating from similar masses of u u and d d quarks, if exact would result in equal numbers of charged ( K + K^{+} and K − K^{-} ) and neutral ( K 0 K^{0} and K ¯ 0 \overline{K}^{0} ) mesons produced in collisions of isospin-symmetric atomic nuclei.

pmc-11341036.title: Usage of social media and Covid 19 vaccine hesitancy among medical students in Kericho County
pmc-11341036.creator: Calvince Otieno Anino, Philip Sanga
pmc-11341036.description: The recent Covid 19 pandemic revealed the global challenge posed by infectious diseases. Vaccines are a crucial tool in preventing pandemics, as evidenced by their success in controlling past outbreaks. The rise of information and communication technology has introduced social media platforms as potential game-changers in both preventing and managing future pandemics.

pmc-11429127.title: User Sentiment Analysis Based on Securities Application Elements
pmc-11429127.creator: Minji Kim, Subeen Kim, Yoonha Park, Sangwoo Bahn, Sung Hee Ahn, Bhavadharani NambiNarayanan
pmc-11429127.description: Designing securities applications for mobile devices is challenging due to their inherent complexity, necessitating improvement through the analysis of online reviews. However, research applying deep learning techniques to the sentiment analysis of Korean text remains limited. This study explores the use of Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) as an effective alternative to traditional user research methods for securities application design.

pmc-12735344.title: Transforming Waste into Value: The Role of Recovered Carbon Fibre and Oil Shale Ash in Enhancing Cement-Based Structural Composites
pmc-12735344.creator: Regina Kalpokaitė-Dičkuvienė, Inga Stasiulaitiene, Arūnas Baltušnikas, Samy Yousef
pmc-12735344.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Economic and technological factors necessitate the use of alternative fuels during oil shale combustion, a process that generates substantial amounts of solid waste with varying ash compositions. This study evaluates the potential of two such waste materials: (i) fly ash derived from the combustion of oil shale (a fine particulate residue from burning crushed shale rock, sometimes combined with biomass), and (ii) short carbon fibres recovered from the pyrolysis (a process of decomposing materials at high temperatures in the absence of oxygen)

pmc-13235715.title: Oedema reduction mediates thrombectomy benefit in large core stroke: secondary analysis of the TENSION trial
pmc-13235715.creator: Gabriel Broocks, Martin Bendszus, Claus Z Simonsen, Götz Thomalla, Elke R Gizewski, Anne Hege Aamodt, Antonin Krajina, Laurent Pierot, Kamil Zeleňák, Blanca Fuentes, Michael D Hill, Andre Kemmling, Lieselotte Vandewalle, Anke Wouters, Robin Lemmens, Jelle Demeestere, Susanne Gellißen, Jens Fiehler,
pmc-13235715.description: PurposeSeveral recent trials have shown improved functional outcomes with endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) in patients presenting with large ischaemic lesions, yet the impact of reperfusion on lesion pathophysiology in this population remains incompletely understood. We hypothesised that EVT reduces ischaemic oedema formation and that attenuation of oedema mediates functional outcome improvement beyond changes in lesion extent.

pmc-13355471.title: Acute portal vein thrombosis postimage-guided liver biopsy in common variable immunodeficiency
pmc-13355471.creator: Satya K. Morar, Kamal N. Morar
pmc-13355471.description: Portal vein thrombosis (PVT) is a rare complication following percutaneous liver biopsy, with an incidence below 0.4% in large multicenter series. We report a 51-year-old male with common variable immunodeficiency (CVID), chronic liver enzyme elevation, and preoperative imaging consistent with cirrhotic morphology, who developed acute abdominal pain within minutes of ultrasound-guided liver biopsy.
